tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (Cipria in light, Notte in dark).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, text fields.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, wells, the question in a receipt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders: decorative, they carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary button, Needs review status): at least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Inchiostro (ink): primary text and the wordmark's letters, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: rosa
tokens.usage: Rosa (pink), the brand colour, always as a surface: highlights, the app icon, the primary button in dark, the cursor and Ipso's eyes in the dark theme, the closing frame of an editorial. Never as text on a light background: use fucsia.

tokens.name: on-rosa
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid rosa.

tokens.name: rosa-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind fucsia or ink text: selected rows, text selection, a highlighted mention.

tokens.name: fucsia
tokens.usage: Fucsia (fuchsia), rosa at text strength: the wordmark cursor and Ipso's eyes in light, links, the focus ring. As text on surface, surface-raised and rosa-soft. In dark it is rosa.

tokens.name: on-fucsia
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid fucsia.

tokens.name: menta
tokens.usage: Menta (mint) means verified and nothing else: the Verified status and Ipso's verified cell. Always as a surface, with on-menta on it.

tokens.name: on-menta
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid menta.

tokens.name: menta-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the Verifying status (menta not yet full), with ink text.

tokens.name: menta-strong
tokens.usage: Menta used as text, icons and the dashed border of the Verifying status: on surface, surface-raised and menta-soft.

tokens.name: carminio
tokens.usage: Carminio (carmine): errors, rejected decisions, destructive actions. As text on surface, surface-raised and carminio-soft.

tokens.name: carminio-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background of the Rejected status and of error messages.

tokens.name: on-carminio
tokens.usage: Text and icons on solid carminio (danger button).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Background of the primary button and of the integration badge: ink in light, rosa in dark.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Background of the primary button on hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and wordmark on action.

tokens.name: pietra
tokens.usage: Pietra (stone): premise dots and neutral marks.

tokens.name: on-pietra
tokens.usage: Text and marks on solid pietra.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor after the wordmark, Ipso's eyes and the caret in code blocks: fucsia in light, rosa in dark.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in text: an alias of fucsia.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px gap in the surface colour. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, from Google Fonts: the terminal typeface. Heavy weights, slightly negative tracking.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and main section titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Instrument Sans, from Google Fonts: a dry grotesque that pairs with the mono without competing. For running text and the interface.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: ipso records the premises, the conclusion and the signature of every decision.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The decision was verified against three premises.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for labels, code and technical values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels and section headers, always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Fingerprints, IDs, keys, numbers in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gap between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline elements, status gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs and statuses, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of inner boxes, gap in compact grids.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, horizontal padding of buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Breathing room around display-xl headlines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inner boxes, integration badge.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, receipts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Statuses (Status) only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers above the content only. Cards and panels use the line border, not a shadow.
